design_choices.current_headroom_condition: mean cell current remains close to2nA;calibrate gain/offset and reject clipping;fixed full-scale is a design resource,not a measured chip limit
design_choices.read_order: native WL select;BL/SL current establish at original bias;ADC sample+convert;affine correction+base4 merge+input/row accumulation;final offset correction;no separate charge-integration/reset stage
design_choices.metadata_lifecycle: Invalidate whole matrix before first erase;accumulate offset-weight sums from canonical,nonduplicated bit-plane data using same metadata bank;publish only after all pages,reference/calibration and metadata complete;no concurrent evaluation during replacement;failure leaves matrix invalid

quantization_diagnostic.ADC_code_step_definition: full_scale/2**bits;nearest code with half-up ties,clipped to0..2**bits-1
quantization_diagnostic.calibration_offset_format: signed Q12.12,24bits,count;zero for the ideal nominal device diagnostic
quantization_diagnostic.reconstruction: quantize each4x4 digit pair per1152-row group;apply finite gain/offset;round count to nearest integer;merge base4 weight digits;accumulate input digits/groups;apply exact digital offset correction
quantization_diagnostic.scope: deterministic ideal device current;finite nominal ADC and declared fixed-point convention;no invented device/noise statistics

resident.maintenance: No mandatory refresh included;endurance/read-disturb/long-window recalibration are separate lifetime/window conditions,not instant tau
